# Bridge: 16 planks (two woods) 8 m along x, 0.9 m wide, 0.08 m thick; rails 0.1 m square along both
# edges. Origin: the deck's top centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new PlankA --base-color 0.5490 0.4627 0.3804 --no-slot
material new PlankB --base-color 0.3059 0.2941 0.3529 --no-slot
material new Rail --base-color 0.1451 0.1647 0.1765 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name P0 --size 1 --location -3.750 0.000 -0.040
scale 0.470 0.840 0.080
apply --scale
material assign PlankA

apply --scale

select P0 P1 P2 P3 P4 P5 P6 P7 P8 P9 P10 P11 P12 P13 P14 P15 RailN RailS
active P0
join
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export bridge.glb
